calls.statement:
SELECT 'fact' src, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, min(order_ts_utc) mn, max(order_ts_utc) mx,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28') day_n,
  count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28') day_d,
  count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' AND status<>'cancelled') day_d_nc
FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stg', count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), min(order_ts_utc), max(order_ts_utc),
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28'),
  count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28'),
  count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' AND status<>'cancelled')
FROM stg_web_order_load

SELECT CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) d, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) dd
FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-20' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-06'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH o AS (SELECT * FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28'),
l AS (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) nl, sum(gross_amount) g, min(channel_code) cc FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) orders, count(l.receipt_id) with_lines, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.receipt_id IS NULL) no_lines,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.line_count<>l.nl) linecount_mismatch,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(o.order_total_gross-l.g)>0.01) total_mismatch,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_total_gross<=0 OR o.line_count<=0) zero_orders,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.dispatch_ts_utc < o.order_ts_utc) bad_dispatch,
 count(DISTINCT (o.member_key, o.order_ts_utc, o.order_total_gross)) distinct_sig
FROM o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id

 count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.utc_day = DATE '2025-11-28') AS lines_utc_28,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.sale_date = DATE '2025-11-28') AS lines_saledate_28
FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN s ON s.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28'
